The '''Slicer House''' was located in the barren wilderness near [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] and was used by a [[Lok slicers|group of slicers]] as their base of operations at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The small building contained three floors: one above ground, two below. The top floor was made up of a single room that contained many terminals arranged in a classroom-like layout. Stairs led down to the first floor below ground which consisted of two rooms. One was a conference room with a large conference table and various wall-mounted [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]]. The other room was larger and lavishly decorated. It contained desks used for studying, a [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] table and various [[computer terminal]]s.<ref name="SWG:GttSH" />
[[File:Lok_slicer_house_interior.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Inside the house.]]

The lowest level consisted of three rooms. A small storage room was filled with crates and containers of all sorts while the second was a sparsely decorated dorm room with bunk-beds and footlockers. The third room was a maintenance room where all kinds of functioning and broken [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were stored, manipulated and repaired, including a [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]], [[LE-series repair droid]]s, various [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] and even a deactivated [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]].<ref name="SWG:GttSH" />

==History==
{{Quote|Most of the bombs are placed in low traffic areas next to machinery. Sometimes there are risks and that bothers me.''"<br />"''Risks?''"<br />"''Yes. Like on Lok. I hear there is a group targeting a room in a building. The next room over is the building sleeping quarters.|A Meatlump ordnance technician and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Ftmp">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the missing parts|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The [[Lok slicers]] inhabited the house after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Members of this group included [[Kelson Sharphorn]], [[Skaelor Tay]] and [[Byd Chillings]]. The building was guarded by several [[IG-106 assassin droid|IG-106]] sentry droids.<ref name="SWG:GttSH" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump terrorists]] had expanded to Lok, establishing a small Meatlump camp near [[Nym's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Muddle the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> They planted an [[Bomb/Legends|explosive device]] in this house, likely planning to destroy the building and the technology in it — which would also have killed the slicers. However, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporters]] [[Vani Korr]] and [[Halden Wes]] who had infiltrated the Meatlump gang discovered the plot.<ref name="SWG:BTLNNS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bomb Target - Lok, Near Nym's Stronghold|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer traveled to Lok, found the bomb in time and managed to defuse it.<ref name="SWG:MtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Slicer House was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GttSH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The slicers and their house were added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> They were indirectly involved in the so-called "[[:w:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]". In the basement of the house, there was a bomb that the player had to defuse as part of the quest "[[:w:c:swg:Muddle the Meatlumps|Muddle the Meatlumps]]." While there were several slicer NPC enemies in the house, none of them had to be killed for the mission.<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> "[[:w:c:swg:Chronicle Relic|Chronicle Relics]]" could be looted from them. Such relics could be used by players in the [[:w:c:swg:Chronicle Quest|Chronicle Quest system]] to create their own quests for other players. By using the relics related to the slicer NPCs, the quests would task the player with killing slicer in the house,<ref name="SWG:relics">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chronicle Relics: "Kill Slicer Sentries", "Kill Slicer Students", "Kill Slicer Quality Assurance Staff Members", "Kill Kelson Sharphorn", "Kill Skaelor Tay", "Kill Byd Chillings"</ref> or just traveling to the house.<ref name="SWG:GttSH" />
